$comment: Single source of truth for the PROJECT_ANALYSIS.md section 9.1 measured-performance budgets,
restated as CI gate thresholds (ADR-001 section 8) — the measured-perf half of the DoD line
"budgets green in CI" (bundle section 9.2 lives in scripts/bundle-budgets.json).
Consumed by lighthouserc.cjs (Lighthouse CI collect/assert) and scripts/check-perf-budget.mjs
(median summary, the non-blocking recommended line, and the uploaded report), so a threshold
change is a one-file diff. Units: lcp/tbt are milliseconds of the Lighthouse metric value,
cls is the unitless layout-shift score. Hard limits fail the build; `recommended` never does.

mobile.description: The section 9.1 measurement condition: Lighthouse's default mobile preset — Moto G class device emulation, simulated slow 4G (1.63 Mbps down / 150 ms RTT) and a 4x CPU slowdown.

desktop.description: Lighthouse desktop preset — desktop form factor, simulated 10 Mbps cable, 1x CPU.

lcp.description: First-load LCP: FAIL above 2500 ms (task DoD threshold, both presets). WARN at >= 1500 ms against section 9.1's RECOMMENDED '< 1.5 s first load' line — non-blocking until the measured mobile LCP (1624 ms) is brought under 1.5 s.

tbt.description: Total blocking time: FAIL above 200 ms (task DoD threshold).

cls.description: Cumulative layout shift: FAIL above 0.1 (task DoD threshold).
